def _build_pwe_matrix(k, G_list, eps_inv_fourier):
    """
    Builds the PWE matrix for TM polarization.
    k: (kx, ky)
    G_list: list of (Gx, Gy)
    eps_inv_fourier: dict mapping (Gx, Gy) to epsilon_inv value
    """
    N = len(G_list)
    M = np.zeros((N, N), dtype=complex)
    for i in range(N):
        kx_i, ky_i = k[0] + G_list[i][0], k[1] + G_list[i][1]
